name: Tree of Life
summary: God places a tree of life in Eden and its loss echoes through the story, with its promise restored at the end.
description:
The tree of life stands at the beginning and the end of the biblical story. Humanity is barred from it after Eden, and its recovery signals the healing of all things.

Wave 1: expand with key passages and connections to wisdom and paradise imagery.

name: Covenants
summary: God binds himself to people with solemn promises, and the pattern of covenant shapes the whole biblical story.
description:
Covenants are formal bonds — with Noah, Abraham, Israel, David, and finally in Jesus — that carry promises, signs, and obligations.

Wave 1: expand with key passages and each major covenant.

name: The Exodus Way
summary: God repeatedly leads people out of bondage and into a promised way of life, and the exodus becomes a pattern for rescue.
description:
The exodus from Egypt becomes the Bible's paradigm of salvation: God hears, delivers, forms a people, and leads them toward a promise.

Wave 1: expand with key passages and later exodus-shaped rescues.

name: Wilderness
summary: The wilderness is a place of testing and formation where God provides and draws his people back to trust.
description:
Wilderness is where dependence on God is learned. Israel, David, Elijah, and Jesus all pass through it.

Wave 1: expand with key passages and wilderness motifs.

name: Mountain
summary: Mountains are where heaven meets earth — places of encounter, revelation, covenant, and kingdom.
description:
From Eden's heights to Sinai, Zion, and the mountain of transfiguration, elevated places mark meetings between God and people.

Wave 1: expand with key passages and mountain scenes.

name: Cities
summary: Cities gather human power and ambition — from Babel to Babylon — yet God designs a city that will be his people's home.
description:
The biblical story traces cities as places of both violence and blessing, culminating in a renewed city coming down from God.

Wave 1: expand with key passages and city themes.
